title: Senior Product Manager, Finance Technology (Procure-to-Pay & Record-to-Report)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Join our Finance Applications team as a Senior Product Manager focused on Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Record-to-Report (R2R). You will own the product roadmap and delivery for the systems and capabilities that support procurement, accounts payable, general ledger, close, consolidation, and financial reporting. Your portfolio will include platforms such as Zip, Coupa, Ramp, NetSuite, Workiva, and related integrations and data products.

 At Reddit, you will partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Engineering, and business systems teams to turn complex operational needs into scalable, secure, and well-controlled solutions. You will lead discovery, prioritize the backlog, define requirements, and guide initiatives from concept through launch and adoption.

 Success in this role requires strong finance process knowledge, sound product judgment, and the ability to move between strategy and execution. You will bring structure to ambiguous problems, make clear tradeoffs, and deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, controls, data quality, and the employee experience.

  

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Own and maintain the product roadmap and backlog for P2P and R2R capabilities, aligned with Finance Technology priorities and business outcomes.

 Partner with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to understand pain points, map current-state processes, and define scalable future-state solutions.

 Translate business needs into clear product requirements, functional specifications, process maps, data flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

 Lead product discovery, fit-gap analysis, solution design, prioritization, and delivery across Zip, Coupa, Ramp, NetSuite, Workiva, integration middleware, reporting, and related finance applications.

 Drive improvements across purchasing, supplier onboarding, invoicing, approvals, payments, general ledger, intercompany, fixed assets, month-end close, consolidation, and financial reporting.

 Lead cross-functional initiatives and system enhancements from planning through testing, deployment, change management, adoption, and post-launch measurement.

 Partner with engineering, business systems analysts, administrators, and external vendors to design secure, supportable solutions, integrations, workflows, automations, and reporting.

 Develop and coordinate test plans, integration testing, and user acceptance testing; ensure releases meet business requirements and control expectations.

 Use product and operational metrics to measure adoption, cycle time, quality, control effectiveness, and business impact, and use those insights to refine priorities.

 Manage production issues and enhancement requests against the roadmap based on severity, business impact, risk, and available capacity.

 Support SOX compliance and audit readiness by embedding appropriate controls, maintaining documentation, and participating in technical and process walkthroughs.
